ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Neptune

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.
